Build command, output directory, and artifact strategy decide what the release pipeline uploads for domains and rollback.
Website Config and domain state feed src/arclayer/site-config.ts instead of becoming project-owned settings.
Framework and source provider tell AI tools and the Management SDK which generated files can be read or patched.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SOURCE_WORKFLOW_CONTENT: Generated runtime helpers read site settings, analytics, and published content through Arclayer delivery APIs.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SOURCE_WORKFLOW_DESC: These checks show whether the selected source mode supports the editor, AI/SDK source operations, runtime content, and release artifacts.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SOURCE_WORKFLOW_PREVIEW: The editor can load the generated site entry and project runtime settings for a read-only preview.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SOURCE_WORKFLOW_RELEASE: Container images are reserved for future SSR/runtime deployment flows and need release infrastructure before launch.
Static builds can publish immutable object-storage bundles for domain routing and release rollback.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SOURCE_WORKFLOW_SOURCE_: Git-backed source is readable in Arclayer, but AI/SDK writes must move through the repository workflow.
Managed source can be read, patched, and deleted by AI tools and the Management SDK.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_BUILDER_OPS_DESC: Pages, reusable sections, content models, and the read-only editor preview stay with Content and Editor because AI CRUD operates on those site-building surfaces.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_BUILDER_OPS_SUMMA: Content Library, Content Models, and Editor
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_DESC: This audit keeps Project Settings focused on project-owned infrastructure and routes website, release, and content decisions to their dedicated surfaces.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_PROJECT_OPS_DESC: These settings are still useful here because they define the project identity, editable source contract, integration keys, environments, and hosted data dependencies.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_PROJECT_OPS_SUMMA: Identity, source, API keys, environments, databases
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_WEBSITE_OPS_DESC: Domain routing, brand assets, SEO, analytics, localization, and publish readiness are no longer project settings; they live under Website and SEO so the release path stays visible.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SCOPE_WEBSITE_OPS_SUMMA: Domains, website config, analytics, SEO, releases
WEBSITE_CONTROL_BRAND_EMPTY_DESC: Add logo, favicon, site title, and title rules before the site is promoted.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_BRAND_READY_DESC: Brand identity is connected to website config and ready for runtime injection.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_DOMAIN_DESC: This is the hostname visitors can use for the current runtime.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_DOMAIN_EMPTY_DESC: Connect a platform or custom hostname before opening the public site.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_READINESS_DESC: Track the public website path from routing to brand identity to release activation.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_RELEASE_ACTIVE_DESC: The active release is what this website currently serves.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_RELEASE_EMPTY_DESC: Publish content before the website has a stable rollback-ready release.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_RELEASE_NO_ACCESS: You do not have permission to publish project releases.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_DESC: Move through preview, content, runtime configuration, and immutable releases without leaving the website control surface.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_LINK_CONFIG_DES: Update site identity, localization, SEO defaults, and analytics before launch.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_LINK_CONTENT_DE: Review pages and reusable sections that feed the next release.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_LINK_EDITOR_DES: Preview the current project site and source anatomy.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_LINK_RELEASES_D: Inspect readiness, publish immutable versions, and rollback when needed.
WEBSITE_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_TITLE: Control the public site from one launch path
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DESC: Set how this project appears to your team and how apps connect to it.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ARCHIVE_DESC: Take the project out of active navigation and stop normal entry. You can restore it from the archived projects list.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ARCHIVE_RUNTIME_WARNING: Archiving removes this project from active work. Existing project data remains stored until the project is permanently deleted.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DANGER_DESC: Archive or permanently delete this project. Review the impact before continuing.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DELETE_DESC: Permanently remove this project and its related resources. This operation cannot be reversed.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_IDENTITY_DESC: Manage the project name, description, and icon. Arclayer maintains the project URL.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ICON_DESC: Used in project navigation, switchers, and project lists.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_SEARCH_EMPTY: No project setting matches that search.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_ADD_DESC: Add a hostname to this runtime and complete TXT verification on the same page.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_BINDINGS_DESC: Platform and custom hosts resolve through one binding table. {{count}} platform hostname stays attached to this runtime.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_DELETE_DIALOG_D: Traffic will stop resolving through this hostname. This action cannot be undone.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_DESC: Connect and verify domains, then deliver the current website release through those hostnames.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_DNS_DESC: Publish this TXT record, then verify the domain.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_DNS_VERIFY_DESC: After the DNS record propagates, run verification to enable domain routing.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_DOMAINS_EMPTY: Create a custom domain when you want traffic to enter through your own hostname.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_ALIASES_DE: Use stable aliases to point preview or production traffic at the current environment.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_ALIAS_SWIT: Choose the environment that this alias should resolve to. New traffic will use the selected target.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_ALIAS_TARG: The alias will resolve to this environment after confirmation.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_CLONE_DESC: Copy models and optional content from the source into an empty environment.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_CLONE_TARG: The target must be empty. Existing target data is not silently overwritten.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_COPY_SUCCE: Environment copy completed: {{models}} models, {{items}} items, and {{versions}} versions.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_DEFAULT_PR: Preview actions route here when a workflow does not choose a specific environment.

SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_DESC: Manage development, preview, and production environments and their active deployments.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_EDIT_DESC: Update the environment label and decide whether this environment should receive preview traffic.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_EMPTY_DESC: Create or bootstrap project environments before managing deployment targets here.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_INCLUDE_CO: When disabled, only model schema and related structure are copied.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_NAME_DESC: Choose the label people see when they ship, inspect, or promote deployments.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_PROMOTE_DE: Replace the selected target with the source schema and optional content. This operation changes the target environment immediately.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_PROMOTE_TA: Existing model and content data in the target will be replaced by the source.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_READ_ONLY_: You can inspect environment identity and linked runtime state here. A project admin can update the environment labels and preview target.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENTS_SOURCE_DES: Schema and content are copied from this environment.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_MEMBERS_DESC: Control who can manage this project and how much editing access they have inside the current workspace.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_MEMBERS_EMPTY: No project members are available yet.
SETTINGS_PROJECT_READ_ONLY_DESC: You can review these settings here. Ask a project admin to make changes.
SETTINGS_SHELL_DESC: Manage your personal settings along with context-aware workspace and project controls.
